gloss: loss on difference; exchange loss; trading loss

definitions.gloss: loss arising from a price or rate difference; exchange loss
definitions.explanation: An accounting term for a loss that arises from the difference between purchase and sale prices or between exchange rates at different times. Most often appears in compounds such as {為替|かわせ}{差損|さそん} (foreign exchange loss).

examples.japanese: ⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧{差損|さそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{円高|えんだか}→円高：04852_endaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{差損|さそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We booked a large exchange loss due to the strong yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧な⟦{円高|えんだか}→円高：04852_endaka⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧{差損|さそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}った→被る：18070_koumuru⟧。
examples.english: Export companies suffered large foreign-exchange losses due to the sudden appreciation of the yen.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference) + ⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧ (loss). Used almost exclusively in business and accounting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧{差損|さそん}: foreign-exchange loss
- {差損|さそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: an exchange loss arises
- {差損|さそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: book/record a loss
- {差損|さそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧: suffer a loss

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {差益|さえき}: gain on difference — its opposite, profit from a favorable rate or price change
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧: loss — general term for any kind of financial loss
